snippet.title: 1000 Deaths Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
1000 Deaths is a gravity-bending 3D platformer where your choices matter. What you choose defines the game's levels, mechanics, and story. Dash through platforming hubs and decide your character's fate while exploring surreal worlds. Speedrun, or don't!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141260/1000_Deaths_Thousand_Deaths/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!
https://youtube.com/sixoneindie
